Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full room-selector payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Choose your room","subtitle":"The Shoreline Resort · Jul 12-15 · 2 guests","currency":"USD","rooms":[{"id":"r1","name":"Ocean View King","bed":"1 King bed","size":"420 sq ft","sleeps":2,"amenities":["Ocean view","Balcony","Free WiFi"],"price":389,"cadence":"night","badge":"Best value"},{"id":"r2","name":"Garden Double Queen","bed":"2 Queen beds","size":"480 sq ft","sleeps":4,"amenities":["Garden view","Free WiFi","Mini bar"],"price":329,"cadence":"night"},{"id":"r3","name":"Beachfront Suite","bed":"1 King + sofa bed","size":"720 sq ft","sleeps":3,"amenities":["Beachfront","Living room","Soaking tub"],"price":612,"cadence":"night","badge":"Only 2 left"}],"submitText":"Reserve","submitValue":"I would like to reserve this room"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading above the room list. Defaults to 'Choose your room'.
- 'subtitle' (string, optional): context line under the title, e.g. 'property · dates · guests'.
- 'currency' (string, optional): ISO currency code used to format room prices. Defaults to 'USD'.
- 'rooms' (array, recommended): the rooms to choose from. Each item MUST have 'name' (string) and SHOULD have 'id' (string) — the 'id'/name is echoed back to you when the guest reserves. Per-room optional fields: 'bed' (string, e.g. '1 King bed'), 'size' (string, e.g. '420 sq ft'), 'sleeps' (number, occupancy), 'amenities' (array of strings; only the first 3 are shown, as chips), 'price' (number, per cadence), 'cadence' (string, defaults to 'night'), 'currency' (string, per-room override of the top-level currency), 'imageUrl' (string, optional; a gradient placeholder is shown if omitted), 'badge' (string, e.g. 'Best value' or 'Only 2 left'). If 'rooms' is empty or omitted the card shows a test-mode sample so it never renders blank — always include real rooms.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): the Reserve button label; defaults to 'Reserve'.
- 'submitValue' (string, optional): the base message sent back to the agent when the guest reserves; the chosen room name and price are appended automatically. Defaults to 'I would like to reserve this room'.

Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
